html:
Subscription Order Confirmation (SOC) Request Form

SOC Request Number: {{ doc.name }}
SOC Type: {{ doc.soc_type }}
Submission Date: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.submission_date) }}
Submitted By / Reseller Sales Partner: {{ frappe.db.get_value('User', doc.submitted_by, 'full_name') or doc.submitted_by }}
Partner: {{ frappe.db.get_value('HD Customer', doc.partner, 'customer_name') or doc.partner }}
SOC Status: {{ doc.soc_status }}

A. End Customer Information

Customer Company Name: {{ doc.customer_company_name }}
Customer Address: {{ doc.customer_address or '-' }}
Customer PIC Name / Position: {{ doc.customer_pic_name or '-' }}{% if doc.customer_pic_position %} / {{ doc.customer_pic_position }}{% endif %}
Customer PIC Email / Phone: {{ doc.customer_pic_email or '-' }}{% if doc.customer_pic_phone %} / {{ doc.customer_pic_phone }}{% endif %}
Email for Super Admin: {{ doc.super_admin_email or '-' }}
Domain Workspace: {{ doc.domain_workspace or '-' }}
Reseller Billing Contact: {{ doc.reseller_billing_contact_email or '-' }}{% if doc.reseller_billing_contact_phone %} / {{ doc.reseller_billing_contact_phone }}{% endif %}

B. Subscription Information

Package Type: {{ doc.package_type }}
Subscription Period: {{ doc.subscription_period or '-' }}
Term of Payment to HR Desk: {{ doc.payment_term or '-' }}
Go-Live Target Date: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.go_live_target_date) if doc.go_live_target_date else '-' }}
Estimated Employee Count: {{ doc.estimated_employee_count or 0 }}
Number of Admin Users: {{ doc.number_of_admin_users or 0 }}
Number of Payroll Groups: {{ doc.number_of_payroll_groups or 0 }}
Implementation Included: {{ 'Yes' if doc.implementation_included else 'No' }}
Training Included: {{ 'Yes' if doc.training_included else 'No' }}

C. Module & Add-On Selection

{% for row in doc.add_ons %}{% else %}{% endfor %}
Module / Add-OnJumlah
{{ row.add_on }}{{ row.quantity }}
Tidak ada add-on yang dipilih.

Dokumen ini adalah formulir permintaan SOC dan bukan bukti tanda tangan atau penerimaan kontrak.
name: SOC Request Form - Standard
